verdict.rationale: Insomnia's natural-language support is narrow. It can generate a mock server from a natural-language prompt plus a URL, OpenAPI, or JSON input, scaffolding routes and responses automatically. It also offers AI commit message suggestions. Nothing in the evidence shows a general natural-language command interface for operating the product itself, such as sending requests, building collections or running tests by prompt. Missing for 10: a general natural-language or chat command interface across core workflows (requests, collections, tests, environments), natural-language control of the Inso CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the prompt-driven features.
